cohort: Obstetric patients in a tertiary care setting in Pakistan who experienced severe maternal complications, critical interventions, or life-threatening situations, identified from 1054 live births.
finding: Out of 1054 live births, there were 42 (3.9%) near-miss cases and 4 (0.3%) maternal deaths, resulting in a maternal mortality ratio of 379/100,000 and a near-miss-to-mortality ratio of 10.5:1.
